BiblicalUsage: Lôwchêsh is the name of Lochesh, an Israelite. In Nehemiah 3:12, "And next unto him repaired Shallum the son of Halohesh"; and in Nehemiah 10:24, "Hallohesh, Pileha, Shobek,".
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Hallohesh is the father whose children built — Shallum repaired the wall with his daughters, and the name stands among the sealers of the covenant.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
